# Software design skill: Expense Tracker

Design the smallest standard-library solution for the Expense Tracker. Trace CLI/API input through `Expense` validation, `ExpenseTracker`, JSON load/save, filtering, totals, and user-facing errors. Record the exact JSON schema, Decimal-as-string decision, category normalization, missing-file policy, atomic-ish write behavior, risks, and mitigations in `docs/design.md` and `docs/implementation-plan.md`. Prefer pure, independently testable boundaries.
